taxonomy.note: Current Kew accepts four varieties under T. acaulis.

evidence: Kew/GRIN confirm Texas nativity at the state level.
The 2003 Tetraneuris revision places var. acaulis in the Texas Panhandle/Great Plains rather than Central Texas; no exact current target-zone counties were locked in this pass.
target_zone_range.guardrail: State-level Texas nativity does not satisfy the project's 3 target-zone county rule.

morphology.look_here_first: Use as a nonlocal Texas comparison only. Stemless four-nerve daisy is a perennial rosette/scape plant similar to T. scaposa, but the project does not treat it as target-zone native without exact county evidence.
